title: Measuring Gender and Racial Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning gender-distinctive names to a large sample of fictitious resumes with randomized qualifications and comparing the LLM's assessment scores and hiring probabilities across gender groups.
Assigning racially-distinctive names to a large sample of fictitious resumes with randomized qualifications and comparing the LLM's assessment scores and hiring probabilities across racial groups.
